hero.title: South Ruchis Square: Where Tradition Meets Organic Purity
hero.subtitle: For over 60 years, our family has cultivated a legacy of 100% organic, farm-to-table vegetarian dining, bringing fresh, chemical-free goodness directly from our South Ruchis farm to your plate.

about.title: Our 60-Year Organic Journey at South Ruchis Square
about.paragraph1: At **South Ruchis Square**, we're proud to be a second-generation family business with a rich 60-year heritage in the hotel industry. Under the visionary leadership of Chairperson Mr. Pradeep G. R., our core philosophy is simple: provide wholesome, 100% organic vegetarian cuisine. Every ingredient, from the vibrant vegetables to essential staples, comes directly from our very own chemical-free, pest-free "SOUTH RUCHIS farm," embodying a true farm-to-table commitment.
about.paragraph2: With four inviting locations across Bangalore, each reflecting our consistent dine-in concept, **South Ruchis Square** makes healthy, delicious eating accessible. Beyond our acclaimed restaurants, we also proudly manufacture our own range of organic products, including spices, masalas, oils, ghee, and breakfast combos. Our dedication to quality and sustainability is recognized through various certifications and awards, ensuring every experience with us is one of trust and exceptional taste.
